name: Explorer Plugin
description: Split-pane Explorer plugin combining FileExplorerPlugin (left column, 260px default, resizable 120-600px via drag handle) and MonacoEditorPlugin (right column, flex-grow). Horizontal flex layout with a 2px col-resize handle between columns. Editor column hidden when no tabs are open. Bridges click-to-open file from explorer to editor. Delegates markdown openers and theme updates. Ctrl+P opens CommandPalette for fuzzy file search. Editor state serialization includes explorer column width and per-tab cursor/scroll positions.

dependencies.usage: File tree browser in left panel

methods.name: openFile
methods.description: Opens a file in the Monaco editor and reveals it in the file explorer tree.

methods.name: closeActiveTab
methods.description: Closes the currently active editor tab. If no tabs remain, hides the editor column.

methods.name: openFileSearch
methods.description: Creates or reveals the CommandPalette overlay for fuzzy file search. Selecting a file opens it in the editor.

methods.name: revealFile
methods.description: Reveals and highlights a file in the file explorer tree via selectFile().

methods.name: setMarkdownOpeners
methods.signature: (labels: string[], callback: (filePath: string, label: string) => void) => void
methods.description: Delegates markdown viewer labels and callback to the file explorer for .md context menu items.

methods.name: updateTheme
methods.description: Propagates current theme to the Monaco editor to sync cockpit-dark/cockpit-light themes.

methods.name: getEditorState
methods.description: Returns serializable editor state including open tabs, cursor/scroll positions, and explorer column width. Returns null if no editor state to save.

methods.name: restoreEditorState
methods.description: Restores editor state from serialized data: opens tabs with cursor/scroll positions and sets explorer column width.

properties.name: editor
properties.description: The Monaco editor instance in the right pane.

properties.name: palette
properties.description: The CommandPalette instance for fuzzy file search, null before first open.

properties.name: onStateChange
properties.description: Callback fired when editor state changes (tab open/close, content change). Used by CanvasArea to trigger save.
